messages.subject: Project Beacon - SPA first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Please find our first draft of the share purchase agreement for Project Beacon. As discussed it follows a fairly standard structure - warranties at Schedule 4, tax covenant at Schedule 5, earn-out at Schedule 6. We've proposed a warranty cap of 25% and a general limitation period of 24 months.

Look forward to your mark-up.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0815
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (redline against your v1). The main commercial moves from the sellers' side: warranty cap down to 20%, general limitation 18 months, tax 6 years, restrictive covenants reduced to 2 years, and de minimis/basket raised. Most of the rest is tidying. Geoffrey is comfortable on the disclosure process.

Happy to take a call this week.

Adam
Denham Lewis LLP
